annotations.title: Get your seller earnings and ledger statement for a period

description: Gets your statement: sales, payable and paid-out earnings, payout key and platform fee, plus every ledger row on your account in the period with its quote and call, and the opening and closing balance. Use it to reconcile sales and earnings, or to audit what your account was charged. Use account_balance instead for just the current balance. Use job_status instead for one call by its proof id. Free: statements are never charged. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST /v1/accounts gives one). Errors (isError, error.code): 400 bad_time, 401 bad_api_key.

from.description: Start of the period (inclusive): ISO 8601 date/time or Unix seconds; omit for the beginning.

to.description: End of the period (exclusive): ISO 8601 date/time or Unix seconds; omit for now.
